theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalForm.markov_transfer_cox {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {N : ℕ} {a b : R} {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {s : ℕ → A} {B : Type u_3} [Ring B] [Algebra R B] {s' : ℕ → B} (hs : HeckeFamily N a b s) (hs' : HeckeFamily N a b s') (z : R) (t : A →ₗ[R] R) (ht1 : t 1 = 1) (hcyc : ∀ (x y : A), t (x * y) = t (y * x)) (hmark : ∀ k < N, ∀ x ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (s '' Set.Iio k), t (x * s k) = z * t x) (t' : B →ₗ[R] R) (ht1' : t' 1 = 1) (hcyc' : ∀ (x y : B), t' (x * y) = t' (y * x)) (hmark' : ∀ k < N, ∀ x ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (s' '' Set.Iio k), t' (x * s' k) = z * t' x) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) (p : ℕ) :
t (cox s n ^ p) = t' (cox s' n ^ p)

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalForm.lift_cox {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {N : ℕ} {a b : R} {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {s : ℕ → A} (hs : HeckeFamily N a b s) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) :
(lift hs) (cox (pgen N a b) n) = cox s n

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalForm.markov_transfer {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {N : ℕ} {a b : R} {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {s : ℕ → A} {B : Type u_3} [Ring B] [Algebra R B] {s' : ℕ → B} (hs : HeckeFamily N a b s) (hs' : HeckeFamily N a b s') (z : R) (t : A →ₗ[R] R) (ht1 : t 1 = 1) (hcyc : ∀ (x y : A), t (x * y) = t (y * x)) (hmark : ∀ k < N, ∀ x ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (s '' Set.Iio k), t (x * s k) = z * t x) (t' : B →ₗ[R] R) (ht1' : t' 1 = 1) (hcyc' : ∀ (x y : B), t' (x * y) = t' (y * x)) (hmark' : ∀ k < N, ∀ x ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (s' '' Set.Iio k), t' (x * s' k) = z * t' x) (x : Pres N a b) :
t ((lift hs) x) = t' ((lift hs') x)

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalForm.pullback_markov {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {N : ℕ} {a b : R} {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {s : ℕ → A} (hs : HeckeFamily N a b s) (z : R) (t : A →ₗ[R] R) (hmark : ∀ k < N, ∀ x ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (s '' Set.Iio k), t (x * s k) = z * t x) (k : ℕ) :

theorem QOU.IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalForm.lift_pgen {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {N : ℕ} {a b : R} {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {s : ℕ → A} (hs : HeckeFamily N a b s) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < N) :
